answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 14586 Country: India Title: Salam walaikum. Most of the people of our community does not allow a pregnent woman attending funeral ceremony. or woman herself avoid it. even though funeral is of her nearest or dearest one. what is the ruling of islam about this? Question: Salam walaikum. Most of the people of our community does not allow a pregnent woman attending funeral ceremony. or woman herself avoid it. even though funeral is of her nearest or dearest one. what is the ruling of islam about this? Answer ID: 14586 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1100/895=L/1430) A pregnant woman can attend the funeral procedures. It is nonsense that your community stops her to do so or she herself avoids. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
